business: Local Work commands execute the current authored operations in the authored candidate pipeline. A journal stays bound to its exact model; unsupported predecessor epochs refuse replay.
bridge: An AlchLang Mapping owns the local authoring pipeline and bindings. The same authored zero-effect operations are used by the native stateful Entry. The generic conductor invokes only independently source-checked compiled operations and mappings; it evaluates no business expressions.
system: Compile the authored AuthorPlan Mapping and every selected stage through original physical source, semantic and computation-domain owners. A bounded generic conductor binds named inputs and propagates exact native Operation failures. Native transaction/Auth surfaces remain unchanged.
alchlang: Define.AuthorPlan and its selected original pure stages
original_owner_tokens: Required throughout; no fabricated capture/domain or accepted-owner object.
generic_adapter_scope: Source capture, checked compilation, artifact hashing and exact-file publication only.
journal_policy: Model digest mismatch refuses replay. No frozen-source fallback for new execution.
journal: cal.define.alch-session-event/v2; command, exact observation, previous hash, model epoch and state hash bound; replay matches both command and observation
